name: Call of Fire

angles.text: Heeding the elements is fundamental to shamanic training. Even in Skywall, communing with fire calls for dedicated guidance and ancestral reverence.
Though native to Skywall's winds, you and the Windshapers know that balance means honoring all four primal elements.

aliases: who do i take the torch to
faq.answer: Olariaan Swiftburn is a shen'dorei Windshaper, deeply attuned to fire. Olariaan lives at the Shrine of Flames, along the Gustberry Lowlands' edge west of Valanaar.
The Shrine of Flames lies in the Gustberry Lowlands of Skywall. It sits along the edge of the floating island expanse, directly west of Valanaar.
faq.q: Where is the Shrine of Flames?

faq.answer: Skywall belongs to air, yet remains part of the wider Elemental Plane. Spirits of all four elements still speak there to those attuned enough to listen.
faq.q: Why is fire being studied in Skywall?

faq.answer: The Torch of Dormant Flame is an elemental focus carried to Olariaan Swiftburn. An initiate brings it to seek instruction in communing with fire.
faq.q: What is the Torch of Dormant Flame?

faq.answer: The Windshapers practice navigating and shaping elemental forces in Skywall. Their ranks include people of varied origins, such as the shen'dorei.
Olariaan Swiftburn teaches disciples to heed the call of fire. Mastering primal forces in Skywall's demanding domain takes great perseverance.
faq.q: What does this quest lead to?

sections.body: Skywall belongs to the air elementals, though its currents reach the wider Elemental Plane. Spirits of earth, water, and fire still speak to those who can hear them. Some Windshapers are especially open to these other forces. Olariaan Swiftburn, a shen'dorei among them, is deeply attuned to fire.
sections.title: Voices Across the Elemental Plane

sections.body: Initiates take the Torch of Dormant Flame to the Gustberry Lowlands. Far along the island rim, west of Valanaar, stands the Shrine of Flames, Olariaan Swiftburn's home. Olariaan receives the dormant flame and offers to teach aspiring students to heed fire's demanding call amid the air realm's churning currents.
sections.title: The Shrine of Flames

summary: In Skywall, initiates carry the Torch of Dormant Flame to Olariaan Swiftburn for teaching. The shrine lies in the Gustberry Lowlands.
